databaseAdmin.title: Database backup and restore
databaseAdmin.description: Export a portable JSON backup or validate and import a backup file. Only safe database metadata is shown; credentials are never displayed.
databaseAdmin.exportDescription: Downloads a DBMS-neutral portable JSON backup with row counts and checksum metadata. Secret fields are redacted by the backend.
databaseAdmin.importDescription: Select a portable backup file and choose dry-run validation, append, or replace restore mode. Run a dry run before restoring production data.
databaseAdmin.replaceWarning: Replace mode deletes existing exported models before importing rows from the backup. This is destructive and cannot be undone from the UI.
databaseAdmin.replaceConfirmationLabel: Type RESTORE to enable replace mode

modes.append: Append: add rows without clearing existing data
modes.replace: Replace: clear known models and restore backup

messages.fileRequired: Select a JSON backup file first.
messages.replaceConfirmationRequired: Type the confirmation phrase before using replace mode.
messages.dryRunSuccess: Backup validated successfully. No data was written.

ismsOperations.title: ISMS Operations
ismsOperations.description: Operational hub for supplier governance, continuity, audits, improvements, awareness, reviews, objectives, workflows, reports and evidence.

domainDescriptions.supplierManagement: Third-party reviews, criticality, requirements and exit readiness.
domainDescriptions.businessContinuity: Business impact analyses, continuity plans and test schedules.
domainDescriptions.auditImprovement: Audit planning, findings, corrective and preventive actions.
domainDescriptions.awarenessTraining: Training assignments, awareness follow-up and completion tracking.
domainDescriptions.managementReview: Leadership reviews, decisions, actions and review cadence.
domainDescriptions.objectivesMetrics: Security objectives, KPI/KRI definitions, thresholds and ownership.
domainDescriptions.workflowAutomation: Operational approval and review workflows across ISMS records.
domainDescriptions.reportsEvidence: Report runs and evidence-ready operational exports.

ismsProcess.title: ISMS Process Workspace
ismsProcess.description: Context, leadership and support under ISO/IEC 27001:2022 — clause 4 (context of the organization), clause 5 (leadership) and clause 7 (support: competence and awareness).

clause4.label: Clause 4 – Context of the organization
clause4.description: Context analysis and management of interested parties and their requirements (ISO/IEC 27001:2022 clauses 4.1–4.4).
clause4.noParties: No interested parties are recorded yet. Add customers, suppliers, employees, regulators and other stakeholders who have an interest in or influence on the ISMS.
clause4.name: Name

clause5.label: Clause 5 – Leadership
clause5.description: ISMS policy, leadership and organizational roles (ISO/IEC 27001:2022 clauses 5.1–5.4). Manage your ISMS documents through the approval workflow (draft → review → approved).
clause5.noDocuments: No ISMS documents are recorded yet. Create your ISMS policy and other core documents here.
clause5.title: Title

clause7.label: Clause 7 – Support
clause7.description: Competence, awareness and communication (ISO/IEC 27001:2022 clauses 7.1–7.4, NIS2 Art. 29). Manage training courses, assignments, completions and awareness acknowledgements.
clause7.title: Title
